description.en: Text-only agents get a timestamped audio timeline for offline audio/video: speech, sound events, music/BPM/downbeats, plus SRT/EDL export, ranked highlights, mixcheck and A/B compare. Requires the Qwen Omni API for basic analysis.
description.zh: 给文本 Agent 一副耳朵：把离线音视频变成带时间戳的音频时间轴（语音、声音事件、音乐/BPM/downbeat），支持 SRT/EDL 导出、高光、mixcheck 和 A/B 对比。basic 分析需要 Qwen Omni API。
